title: Reconcile lifecycles and retain spec synthesis
description: Integrate layer reports into a coherent mental model of identity, boot/join, authenticated forwarding, compression, time/capacity, route scope, security, custody, gateways, and LCI. Verify disputed passages against decisions and primary chapters. Persist concise durable Beads notes and provide source-linked user synthesis.
acceptance_criteria: Source-backed end-to-end explanation; unresolved ambiguities identified without inventing decisions or claiming implementation conformance; no source/spec edits.
notes:
SPEC COMPREHENSION CHECKPOINT, 2026-09-08. Research only; no source/spec edits, tests, implementation-conformance claims, commits or upstream writes. Seven parallel layer readers covered all current spec chapters/appendices/drafts; coordinator read architecture, rationale, history, acknowledgments and reconciled cross-layer passages; eighth reader mapped constants and vector provenance. All 17 spec/decisions.jsonl records read. docs/firmware-time-provider.md also read.

MODEL: LICHEN is a key-identified, airtime-constrained IPv6 mesh, with expendable datagrams and durable application messages as separate services. It composes IETF protocols with project-specific link framing, Schnorr48, Announce gradients, CCP and application contracts. It is standards-based, not entirely unchanged RFCs. Isolated operation is mandatory; a routing/time root is not necessarily an Internet-connected BR or an identity CA.

IDENTITY/ROUTING: Full Ed25519 public key is security identity. IID=SHA512(pubkey)[0:8] with U/L cleared; wire EUI64 toggles that bit once. Native address=02 || hash[0:7] || IID. Native /128 is stable and self-derived; fe80 is direct-link control. The upstream Yggdrasil bit-packing algorithm differs explicitly (test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json:3-8); prefix overlap is not identity interoperability/global reachability. spec/appendix-border-router.md:6-11 prohibits gateway source spoofing and requires identity-preserving global transport or explicit proxies. RPL non-storing holds downward topology at root, while separate Announce gradients serve peers. LOADng requires authenticated local evidence with monotonic 1200-second lifetime, not arbitrary-address flooding. GPSR greedy-only, backpressure, DTN and opportunistic extensions are independently optional; scoped multicast still floods under budgets. Current DAO targets exactly origin-owned native /128 with E=0; generalized prefixes are explicitly future (05-routing:445-460).

AUTHENTICATED PACKET PATH: Bounds-safe frame parsing -> verify immediate signer/full-key generation -> replay acceptance -> reassembly/decompression -> network/semantic authorization -> state commit/delivery. Relays reassemble/decompress, forward IPv6 with permitted Hop Limit/source-route changes, recompress/refragment and sign a NEW link frame with relay SIID/counter. End-to-end origin is distinct: Announce and DAO have their own signatures; OSCORE protects application endpoints. Current link frame is Length|LLSec|Epoch|Seq|DST|SIID|Payload|48-byte MIC. Signature domain is LICHEN-LINK-v1 plus NUL; DST_LEN is authenticated non-wire delimiter. 255-byte PHY ceiling leaves 186 payload bytes for signed extended unicast, then 185 after dispatch. Dispatch 0x14=SCHC and 0x15=control. Schnorr48 is challenge16+response32, NOT a sliced Ed25519 signature; use detailed Schnorr draft, not incompatible summary pseudocode.

PERSISTENCE/AUTHORITY: Link replay counter is finite epoch:u8 + sequence:u16, 32-frame window, never modular wrap; full key plus current opaque trust generation owns state, not IID/SIID. Epoch exhaustion fails closed and requires identity rotation (decision17). DAO uses separate persistent nonwrapping u64 Origin Sequence and exact signed bytes; root persists sequence+digest before exposing route/ACK, permits identical retransmission to rebuild volatile routes after restart without refreshing present routes (05-routing:320-443). OSCORE sender reservations/receiver replay and correlation state must be persisted before nonce use/plaintext release when keys survive reboot. Fresh context recovery requires distinct key/nonce material. TOFU proves pinned-key continuity, not honesty or Sybil resistance. EDHOC Suite0/OSCORE uses standard mechanisms; link Schnorr and OTA Ed25519 signatures are separate. OTA firmware key is not node link key. Signing does not automatically grant root/time/prefix/admin authority.

SCHC: Rule Set Version3; immutable preprovisioned rules, authenticated DIO version compatibility gate. Canonical table appendix-schc: fixed CoAP/OSCORE headers 23 bytes link-local, 37 native (including rule and CoAP base, excluding tail); MQTT-SN21/37; rules0-7 and255. Canonical DIO ff02::1a cannot match unicast Rule3 and uses Rule255, including solicited responses (decision6). Rule255 RX is byte-preserving after structural/checksum validation; endpoint policy belongs to emission/forwarding (decision4). Unknown rule is dropped, never guessed as255. ACK-on-Error fragmentation M1/N6/T0, 179-byte tiles, full-key/generation sessions, one transfer per direction, 60-second terminal hold-down, opener W0/FCN62; RCS covers encoded packet plus zero padding octet. Reassemble each hop. Distinguish raw versus encoded packet limits; texts disagree at22554-byte ceiling.

CAPACITY/TIME: SF10/BW125/CR4/5 baseline; sync word0x34; max255-byte airtime2295.808ms, scheduled minimum2346ms including single trailing50ms guard (02a:111,381). At1% duty, only36 seconds/hour total airtime: signatures, control and retries count. Slot=u32(FNV1a32(wire EUI64)+u32(SFN)) mod N, N default8. Channel selection has explicit wire-EUI BE + epoch LE serialization; do not replace with generic hash rule. TX permission intersects valid sync, slot-map membership, complete-packet fit before guard, CCA and locally provisioned regional plus adaptive airtime ceilings. Radio messages cannot expand local regulatory permissions. Distinguish monotonic uptime/cache age, validated Unix wall time, schedule epoch, wrapping SFN, and NONwrapping link epoch. Build/provision epoch is a plausibility floor, not a clock source. GNSS position and time validity differ. Authentication is insufficient for clock authority. Decisions pin GUARD_PPM5000, density>10, uncompressed TDMA beacon, Imax1024s and SF-decrease hysteresis; the hysteresis numeric threshold is not in the ledger.

APPLICATION/LCI: Raw UDP uses port dispatch, not historical generic app-type byte. CoAP5683, MQTT-SN10883, generic CBOR60, SenML-CBOR112. Sensors, positions/privacy, waypoints, messaging/canned text, SOS, presence/checkin, range diagnostics, groups, dead drops/confessions are separate resources with distinct persistence/security. Datagram queues are tiny, bounded and deadline-based; do not silently give telemetry custody. Message service uses S/C flags and /msg/custody: persist opaque body before2.01, previous custodian then releases copy, final recipient acceptance and application receipt are separate. Sending=no custody, Sent=accepted custody, Delivered=receipt/ack_through, Expired=may not have arrived. A radio ACK/SCHC ACK/CoAP ACK is not proof of end-to-end delivery or human reading. Custody needs valid expiry clock and is required on BRs, optional leaves. LCI authoritative native interface is IPv6+CoAP over SLIP USB/serial/BLE or packet IPC; legacy C1/integer-command protocol is not current. /proxy optional, not assumed core. Node owns state; UI uses Observe. Shared screens Messages/Map/Peers/Status plus Settings/Keys across phone, device, TUI and web.

DOCUMENT AUTHORITY/PROVENANCE: Decisions adjudicate only their recorded subjects. Follow explicit canonical chapter/appendix references; overview prose, examples, draft status and implementation claims are not interchangeable. test/vectors is canonical; spec/test-vectors consists of five separate ordinary files, not symlink mirrors. Constants TOML and vector README also contain stale values (e.g.250/100ms versus2346/50ms slots/guard; obsolete rule8). No automatic constant generator was established. EDHOC fixtures explicitly distinguish regression vectors from RFC9529 anchors; OSCORE has RFC8613 anchors. Cross-implementation parity is necessary but not proof of standards/crypto conformance. No tests were run in this reading session.

UNRESOLVED CONTRACTS, NOT UNILATERALLY DECIDED: (1) Global Yggdrasil promises in04-network:34-54 conflict with actual address derivation and BR identity-preserving boundary; draft-yggdrasil-subnet-announcement is a proposal requiring upstream changes. (2) LCI11:151-181 defines only client link-local addresses while11:556-583 mandates direct remote routing with optional proxy; routable client source and return-route mechanism are unspecified, especially with DAO self-/128 restriction. (3) CCP02a:134 and GCP prefer lower stratum including0, whereas09:314-342 defines0=invalid,4=GNSS and09:379-446 prefers higher. (4) Fixed SF10 profile02a:381 conflicts with in-schedule ADR02a:593-630; continuous CH0 reception even on other channels629 conflicts with single-radio feasibility. Density>10 collapses toCH0 and increases SF;02a:403-411 explicitly admits conflict with dense deployment aims. (5) Custody retry/ownership promises12-apps:142-154,253-268 conflict with eviction of live accepted messages295-306. (6) Key rotation06:280-289 signs fixed domain transcript;06:354-365 specifies COSE/hash transcript instead. (7) Raw-vs-encoded SCHC ceiling03:282-287 versus464-477; RCS all-tiles-failed recovery draft519-524 versus634-637. (8) SIID collision candidate policy differs physical-link270-299 versus link draft206-215/262-270. (9) UI /status/node binding versus minimum /status contract; receipt ack_through lacks contiguous ordering guarantees. Additional layer readers noted provisional COSE example/OTA/SenML schema drift; do not treat illustrative bytes or safety/scale claims as vetted guarantees. These are analysis caveats, not findings of runtime bugs. No design choice, interoperability shim or fix was authorized by this reading task.
close_reason: Completed cross-layer reconciliation; source-linked mental model, lifecycle invariants, authority distinctions, canonical-vector provenance, and unresolved normative conflicts retained in issue notes and keyed Beads memory. No source/spec changes or implementation-conformance claims; verification was source cross-reading, not tests.
